runs.title: Start here · 12-second tour
runs.heading: Two useful examples, with different levels of help
runs.input: First half: SAM 2 gets points chosen by Codex. Second half: SAM 3.1 gets object names only.
runs.watch: First, watch the colored cow mask follow the animal. Then watch SAM 3.1 select trees and grass while leaving the cow unmarked.

runs.title: SAM 2 · Given points to follow
runs.heading: Can SAM 2 follow an object once we point it out?
runs.input: Codex supplied four points on the first frame: cow, tree, grass and sword. The model then followed the selected areas.
runs.watch: The cow mask fits well at first. The “sword” mask covers only a small patch, and some masks disappear as the view changes. This tests assisted tracking, not recognition from words.

runs.title: SAM 3.1 · Asked to find objects by name
runs.heading: Can SAM 3.1 find and follow objects from words?
runs.input: Only the words “cow”, “tree”, “grass” and “sword”. No points or masks were supplied.
runs.watch: It selects trees and grassy terrain. It does not select the cow or sword in this clip, even while the cow is clearly visible.

runs.title: SAM 3 · Asked to identify each frame
runs.heading: What does SAM 3 recognize in each image?
runs.input: The same four words, applied to each frame separately. Matching between frames is simple and can change object IDs.
runs.watch: It selects trees and grass, but watch the “sword” label: it initially marks the inventory icon instead of the held sword. The cow is almost always missed.
